explainer_content.short_definition: 1990s New York rap canon: hard sample drums, street detail, lyrical authority, and myth-sized MC personas.
explainer_content.history_capsule: After hip-hop's early and golden-age breakthroughs, East Coast 90s rap sharpened boom-bap production and street storytelling into a dominant album-era language.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It set high standards for rap lyricism, street narrative, producer-MC chemistry, and album canon debates.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The drums hit square and dry while the MC carries detail, threat, humor, and autobiography.
